definitions.explanation: To have an opinion or belief about something. Often used with と思う to express one's thoughts.
To have an emotional response or impression. そう思う (I feel that way).
To anticipate or assume something. 雨が降ると思う (I think it will rain).

examples.japanese: 明日は晴れると思います。
examples.english: I think it will be sunny tomorrow.
I don't think he will come.
examples.notes: Negative inside the quote, not on 思う

notes: 思う is extremely common for expressing opinions. The pattern 〜と思う is essential. Note that Japanese often puts the negative inside: 来ないと思う (think won't come) rather than 来ると思わない. Compare with 考える (かんがえる) which implies more deliberate thinking/reasoning. Te-form: 思って.
